finding: Women who underwent cesarean section had a higher neutrophil-lymphocyte ratio at 24 hours postpartum compared to those who delivered vaginally, and an increased neutrophil-lymphocyte ratio was correlated with delayed onset of lactation.
mod_finding: The neutrophil-lymphocyte ratio in the caesarean section group was higher than that in the vaginal delivery group and was related to a delayed onset of lactation.
